posts.body: Midterms are officially over. I am celebrating with the biggest coffee I can find and a new mixtape.
Who is up for a late showing downtown tonight? I need a movie with explosions and zero homework.
Found a fantastic used copy of OK Computer for five dollars. The universe is looking out for me.
Spring is trying to happen. Took the long way home and remembered why this city is worth the traffic.
Experiment result: instant noodles taste better after midnight, but only if someone else adds the hot sauce.
Road trip idea for next weekend: coast, cheap diner, terrible singalong playlist. Who is in?
New record night at my place Friday. Bring a favorite album and a story about why you love it.
The first warm afternoon of the year deserves a walk, a camera, and ice cream.
The campus radio spring concert lineup is finally posted. I am already making a setlist for the drive there.
Coffee shop study table claimed. Come by if you need a break or a spare pen.
Packing list for the weekend: sneakers, map, snacks, and absolutely no alarm clock.
Small victories: finished my paper, found a sunny bench, and remembered to call home.

Count me in for the concert and the drive home playlist.
